collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DREAMS AND AMBITIONS (DRM-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Big dreams, small dreams, secret dreams and silly ones: things villagers hope for, work toward, give up on, change their minds about, or simply enjoy imagining. Ambition is optional, and a dream that never comes true is not a sad ending.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult)

collection.description: A villager sets off to find where the stream begins, and a friend offers company: go together, or go alone.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has always wondered where the stream starts. It comes down out of the hills, and nobody (subject.he/she) knows has ever followed it all the way up. Today (subject.he/she) has packed some food and is setting off upstream. (friend) asks if (subject.he/she) wants company.

text_only.reason: food in the story (a meal, a catch, fruit); the village's stores do not change -- the draft's notes: everything but the marked effects is story only

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) goes alone, and climbs until late afternoon, and doesn't find the start. The stream just keeps going, up into thicker forest. (subject.He/she) turns back at a waterfall, so as to be home before dark. (subject.He/she) still doesn't know where it begins. (subject.He/she) finds (subject.he/she) is quite glad about that.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: They follow the stream up through the trees, over rocks, past waterfalls, until it gets narrower and narrower and finally turns into a lot of small wet trickles coming out of a mossy hillside. "Is that it?" says (friend). "I suppose so," says (subject). It's a bit of a let-down. It's also, somehow, wonderful.
